description: Implementation of a non-blocking, event-driven socket class for QUIC protocol, managing connection, send, receive, and socket event handling.

classes.name: EventLoopConnectingClientSocket
classes.description: A socket class supporting asynchronous and blocking connect, send, and receive operations with event-driven notifications.

methods.name: ConnectBlocking
methods.description: Performs a blocking connect operation on the socket.

methods.name: ConnectAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous connect operation.

methods.name: Disconnect
methods.description: Closes the socket and resets internal state.

methods.name: GetLocalAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local socket address after connection.

methods.name: ReceiveBlocking
methods.description: Performs a blocking receive operation.

methods.name: ReceiveAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous receive operation.

methods.name: SendBlocking
methods.description: Sends data in a blocking manner.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous send operation.

methods.name: OnSocketEvent
methods.description: Handles socket events for connect, read, write, and error notifications.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Creates and configures the socket.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes and unregisters the socket.

methods.name: DoInitialConnect
methods.description: Performs the initial connect attempt.

methods.name: GetConnectResult
methods.description: Checks the result of an asynchronous connect.

methods.name: FinishOrRearmAsyncConnect
methods.description: Completes or re-arms the async connect process based on status.

methods.name: ReceiveInternal
methods.description: Performs the internal receive operation.

methods.name: FinishOrRearmAsyncReceive
methods.description: Completes or re-arms the async receive process.

methods.name: OneBytePeek
methods.description: Peeks at one byte to check socket state.

methods.name: SendBlockingInternal
methods.description: Performs the internal blocking send operation.

methods.name: SendInternal
methods.description: Performs the internal send operation, possibly multiple times.

methods.name: FinishOrRearmAsyncSend
methods.description: Completes or re-arms the async send process.
